effects.description: (4 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) Casting an Earthen Heart ability grants you a Rock Stance for |cffffff10|r seconds. While on your Primary Weapon you gain Molten Stance, granting you Major Heroism, generating |cffffff3|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds. While you are on your Secondary Weapon you gain Obsidian Stance, increasing your Healing Done and damage shields by |cffffff14|r%. 

Bar Swapping will swap your Stance automatically.
